entities.name: Vohar
entities.description: A merfolk of Dominaria and would-be usurper of Vodalia, later compleated and devoted to New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Mihail II
entities.description: Ruler of Vodalia whom Vohar sought to overthrow.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: Phyrexian whose incursion awoke an ancient Phyrexian on the sea floor.

events.summary: Vohar sought to seize control of Vodalia from Mihail II.
events.quote: Vohar sought to seize control of the empire from Mihail II

events.summary: Vohar's plot was discovered and he was banished to the abyssal layer of the oceans.
events.quote: Vohar was banished to the abyssal layer

events.summary: Vohar was compleated by an ancient Phyrexian on the sea floor.
events.quote: he encountered an ancient Phyrexian on the sea floor

relations.quote: Vohar still seeks the destruction of Mihail
